string.text: An engine-native LuaJIT sampling profiler. One capture covers the whole modpack at near-zero overhead. It names the mod behind each hot script and writes a ranked report with a SpeedScope flamegraph.

Press F11 for the ImGui overlay and pick JitProfiler in the menu bar, then start a CPU or memory capture. From the console (launch with -dbg): run_string JitProfiler.start_cpu(), play, then stop_cpu(). Reports write to appdata\logs.
To read a flamegraph, open speedscope.app in a browser and drag the .folded file in. It runs locally and nothing leaves the machine.
Adds JitProfiler to the F11 ImGui menu bar. Off hides its panel and banner. The console commands still work.
